description: Build the Flowgent.Runtime/Maf adapter seam (the heart of the migration, design sections 3,5-12,14) and re-wire the run pipeline onto MAF declarative workflows while keeping the whole operational surface. Adds the agent provider over the engine IChatClient, pluggable conversation store, MCP tool handler (JSON-string result), Demo response provider, PowerFx conversion, per-run workflow factory, run driver, graph projector, trial-build validator, and the volume/http definition sources; re-wires RunContext/RunOrchestrator/RunRecorder, ModuleCatalog(Service), IntakeService.RenderTitle, EngineEndpoints projection, and DI. All declarative types stay inside the Flowgent.Runtime.Maf namespace. Depends on FEAT-001 (extractions, probes) and FEAT-002 (WorkflowDescriptor). Uses the PROBE-A/B/C-selected forms recorded in tasks.md by FEAT-001. No custom-format code is deleted here (FEAT-005); the old compiler/step-handler registrations are just dropped from DI so the MAF path drives runs.
steps: Agent provider (design section 6): add backend/src/Engine/Flowgent.Runtime/Maf/MafAgentProvider.cs extending ResponseAgentProvider, patterned on spike/Spike.MafDeclarative/SpikeAgentProvider.cs, ONE instance per run. InvokeAgentAsync resolves the agent via run ModuleDefinition.FindAgent (persona/role for telemetry), builds a ChatClientAgent on the engine IChatClient via AsAIAgent(new ChatClientAgentOptions{...}), sets ChatOptions.ResponseFormat = ChatResponseFormat.ForJsonSchema(...) from the step output schema, and attributes the call with LlmCallAttribution.ForAgent(options, agentId, moduleId, workflowId, runId, stepId) so LlmTelemetryMiddleware records it. In Demo mode (LlmOptions.IsDemo) it resolves demo JSON from the injected DemoResponseProvider and attaches it with LlmCallAttribution.WithDemoResponse so DemoChatClient returns it. On the assign-agent path the workflow writes Global.assignedAgentId (read by the run driver -> RunContext.AssignAgent).

Conversation store (design section 6): add backend/src/Engine/Flowgent.Runtime/Maf/IConversationStore.cs (CreateConversationAsync/AppendAsync/GetAsync/ListAsync keyed by runId) and RunConversationStore.cs (default, run-model-backed, held for the run lifetime). MafAgentProvider's CreateConversationAsync/CreateMessageAsync/GetMessageAsync/GetMessagesAsync delegate to it; register it swappably in DI.

MCP tool handler (design sections 5.2,12): add backend/src/Engine/Flowgent.Runtime/Maf/ModuleToolHandler.cs implementing IMcpToolHandler, patterned on spike SpikeMcpToolHandler.cs. It maps serverLabel -> moduleId and toolName -> module tool name, looks up the run's live ModuleDefinition (per-run context), calls ModuleToolInvoker.InvokeAsync, and returns the output as ONE non-numeric JSON string in one TextContent: `new McpServerToolResultContent(callId){ Outputs = [ new TextContent(result is null ? "null" : result.ToJsonString()) ] }`. Enforce the non-numeric invariant (a bare top-level number is wrapped so the Value cell is always a string).

PowerFx conversion (design section 11): add backend/src/Engine/Flowgent.Runtime/Maf/PowerFxConversion.cs with JsonNode<->JSON-string helpers (JsonNode.Parse for string->node when reading Global.<stepId> snapshots; ToJsonString for node->string when injecting demo outputs / the intake object). No FormulaValue<->JsonNode record binding.

Workflow factory (design section 8): add backend/src/Engine/Flowgent.Runtime/Maf/MafWorkflowFactory.cs wrapping DeclarativeWorkflowBuilder.Build<JsonObject>(new StringReader(run.Workflow.Yaml), options, MapInput). options carries the per-run MafAgentProvider + ModuleToolHandler via DeclarativeWorkflowOptions(agentProvider){ McpToolHandler = handler }. MapInput is the PROBE-C-selected form: either `JsonObject input => new ChatMessage(ChatRole.User, input.ToJsonString())` (ParseJSON path) or the named-trigger-argument transform (structured-args path) per the FEAT-001 verdict.

Run driver (design sections 8,11): add backend/src/Engine/Flowgent.Runtime/Maf/MafRunDriver.cs wrapping InProcessExecution.RunStreamingAsync / WatchStreamAsync / SendResponseAsync. It translates declarative events (MessageActivityEvent, WorkflowOutputEvent, WorkflowErrorEvent, RequestInfoEvent, per-action events) into the seam's own neutral event records so RunOrchestrator never sees a declarative type; it reads each Global.<stepId> JSON-string variable from run state (PROBE-B mechanism) and calls RunContext.SetOutput(stepId, JsonNode.Parse(value)); it reads Global.assignedAgentId -> RunContext.AssignAgent. It bridges RequestInfoEvent <-> HumanInputRegistry (register on request; SendResponseAsync with ExternalInputResponse carrying JSON {decision,reason} when HumanInputService completes). It derives StepStarted/StepCompleted for RunRecorder from the per-action signals (PROBE-B default) keyed by action id.

RunContext (design section 8): modify backend/src/Engine/Flowgent.Runtime/Execution/RunContext.cs to carry WorkflowDescriptor (not WorkflowDefinition); drop Templates, CreateScope, CreateIntakeScope, and EnterStep's budget (MAF owns step scheduling); keep RunId, Module, Workflow, Input, Title, RunToken, AssignedAgentId+AssignAgent, CurrentStepId, SetOutput/GetOutput/SnapshotOutputs.

RunOrchestrator (design section 8): rewrite backend/src/Engine/Flowgent.Runtime/Execution/RunOrchestrator.cs RunWorkflowAsync to build via MafWorkflowFactory.BuildAsync(run) and run via the seam (MafRunDriver), consuming the neutral stream: per-step StepStarted/StepCompleted via RunRecorder with output from Global.<stepId>; RequestInfoEvent -> AwaitingInput + registry + resume; WorkflowOutputEvent -> one terminal Completed/Failed transition whose outcome (success/failure) comes from the descriptor's manifest terminals[] for the reached terminal id; WorkflowErrorEvent/executor failure -> FailAsync(stepId, reason); abort/shutdown via runToken/hostToken -> Cancelled/Failed 'Aborted by user' unchanged. Keep the existing structure (availability checks, RunRegistry, exactly one terminal transition). The dual-write RecordAsync, RunUpdateChannel publication, gRPC RunMonitor shape, RunStatus set, and current-step-id are preserved because the orchestrator still drives RunRecorder/RunStore.

RunRecorder (design section 8): modify backend/src/Engine/Flowgent.Runtime/Execution/RunRecorder.cs so StepStarted/StepCompleted are driven from the seam's neutral events (keeping the dual-write event shape).

Demo response provider (design section 7): add backend/src/Engine/Flowgent.Runtime/Llm/DemoResponseProvider.cs, pure and keyed by (workflowId, stepId): `JsonNode Resolve(string workflowId, string stepId, string renderedPrompt, RunContext run)`. jokes.tell extracts topic from the rendered prompt ('Tell a joke about: <topic>') and interpolates to the byte-identical '[Demo] Why did the <topic> cross the road? To get to the other side.'. support.classify runs RuleMatcher.Match(classifyRules, renderedPrompt, ignoreCase:true) over the three current rules authored as MatchRule and selects classifyRules[matches[0]].Output or the default when empty. support.resolve/support.generate_code fill placeholders from RunContext.GetOutput(classify/locate_component/resolve); the severityAssessment Scriban expression becomes a C# switch (lowercased text contains injection|security -> Critical; exception|crash -> High; else Medium). template-hello.summarize relocated likewise.

Graph projector (design section 10): add backend/src/Engine/Flowgent.Runtime/Maf/WorkflowProjector.cs projecting a descriptor's YAML + manifest terminals[] into WorkflowGraphModel: one node per declarative action with dashboard kind (InvokeAzureAgent->llm, InvokeMcpTool->tool, Question->human-input, ConditionGroup->rule, SetVariable->map, terminal SendActivity/end->terminal); exclude plumbing SetVariable nodes (*_snapshot, read_input, rt_text/rt_a/rt_b) by naming/role convention; ConditionGroup conditions -> GraphEdge(from, to=GotoAction.actionId, label=friendly PowerFx), elseActions -> default edge, sequential next -> unlabeled edge; terminal outcome tagged from manifest terminals[]. Wire it into ModuleLoader (via the projector interface FEAT-002 defined) so it runs once at load.

Trial-build validator (design section 4.3): add backend/src/Engine/Flowgent.Runtime/Maf/DeclarativeValidation.cs implementing IDeclarativeDefinitionValidator; trial-build each descriptor YAML with DeclarativeWorkflowBuilder.Build<JsonObject> using a no-op agent provider + no-op MCP handler; build exceptions become DefinitionErrorInfo(file=workflow path, message=builder error, line=best-effort). Inject it into ModuleCatalog.ApplyPackage (modify backend/src/Engine/Flowgent.Runtime/Modules/ModuleCatalog.cs) to merge errors before marking Available/Invalid, keeping Definitions declarative-free.

Definition sources (design sections 4.2,4.1): add backend/src/Engine/Flowgent.Runtime/Modules/IDefinitionSource.cs (Name; Task<PackageFetchResult> FetchAsync(moduleId, knownVersion, ct)); VolumeDefinitionSource.cs (primary, reads Flowgent:Definitions:Path, builds ModulePackage with ModuleLoader.ReadPackage + ComputeVersion, NotModified when knownVersion==computed else Changed); HttpDefinitionSource.cs (secondary, wraps IModuleClient.FetchPackageAsync unchanged). Re-wire backend/src/Engine/Flowgent.Runtime/Modules/ModuleCatalogService.cs to pick volume when the path is configured and the module folder exists there, else HTTP; keep the polling loop, atomic swap, retry-on-interval, and never-wait-for-modules behavior.

Endpoints + intake (design sections 10,14): modify backend/src/Services/Flowgent.Engine.Service/Endpoints/EngineEndpoints.cs so ToWorkflowInfo/BuildGraph use the descriptor and map WorkflowGraphModel -> Contracts WorkflowGraph; keep /api/engine routes/shapes/status codes unchanged. Modify backend/src/Engine/Flowgent.Runtime/Intake/IntakeService.cs so RenderTitle uses a tiny {field} interpolation over the input object instead of Scriban (title null when no simple template); input validation against descriptor.InputSchema and 202/400/404/503 unchanged.

DI (design section 15): modify backend/src/Engine/Flowgent.Runtime/RuntimeServiceExtensions.cs to register MafAgentProvider (per-run factory), ModuleToolHandler, DemoResponseProvider, IConversationStore->RunConversationStore, IDeclarativeDefinitionValidator, MafWorkflowFactory, MafRunDriver, IDefinitionSource impls, and ModuleToolInvoker; DROP the IStepHandler registrations and the WorkflowCompiler registration (the orchestrator no longer uses them). Do not delete the step-handler/compiler files here (FEAT-005).
acceptance_criteria: All Microsoft.Agents.AI.Workflows.Declarative usage is confined to types in the Flowgent.Runtime.Maf namespace; nothing in Contracts/Definitions/domain or elsewhere in Runtime references it.

RunOrchestrator builds the MAF workflow per run via MafWorkflowFactory and records exactly one terminal transition via the dual-write RunStore; the gRPC RunMonitor stream shape and RunStatus set are unchanged.

DemoResponseProvider, WorkflowProjector, PowerFxConversion, and VolumeDefinitionSource are unit-testable and have passing unit tests (jokes topic interpolation; classify rule selection; severity switch; graph nodes/edges with when labels + terminal outcomes; version/ETag parity; string<->node round-trip).
`dotnet build backend/Flowgent.slnx` succeeds with no new warnings.
findings:
DONE under parent decision 'option A' (the engine-test gate on FEAT-003 is a plan defect — it is unsatisfiable here because the module YAMLs are custom-format until FEAT-004 and tests are ported in FEAT-005). Achievable gate MET: `dotnet build backend/Flowgent.slnx` = 0 warnings / 0 errors; Flowgent.Architecture.Tests = 25/25 green (the existing rules, incl. Definitions-only-Contracts and no-AspNetCore-in-Runtime, still hold with the seam).

SEAM BUILT (all declarative types confined to namespace Flowgent.Runtime.Maf): MafAgentProvider (per-run ResponseAgentProvider over the engine IChatClient; attaches DemoResponseProvider output + LlmCallAttribution; stepId carried via the InvokeAzureAgent input argument 'stepId' = MafAgentProvider.StepIdArgument; dynamic agent via input arg 'agentId' else ModuleDefinition.FindAgent; AssignAgent on resolve), IConversationStore + RunConversationStore (in-memory, per-run, swappable in DI), ModuleToolHandler (IMcpToolHandler -> ModuleToolInvoker; result = ONE non-numeric JSON string in one TextContent; bare top-level number wrapped as {"value":n} to avoid the InvokeMcpTool 'Double' crash), PowerFxConversion (JSON-string <-> JsonNode), MafWorkflowFactory (DeclarativeWorkflowBuilder.Build<JsonObject> + DeclarativeWorkflowOptions{McpToolHandler}; per-run), MafRunDriver (InProcessExecution.RunStreamingAsync with CheckpointManager.CreateJson+FileSystemJsonCheckpointStore; translates declarative events to neutral MafRunEvent records; HITL via RequestInfoEvent -> ExternalInputResponse carrying {decision,reason} JSON; reads Global.* from checkpoint via ExtractGlobals/ReadValueCell), WorkflowProjector (IWorkflowGraphProjector; action-kind->dashboard kind, ConditionGroup->labelled edges, excludes plumbing SetVariable rt_*/read_input/*_snapshot, terminal outcome from manifest), DeclarativeValidation (IDeclarativeDefinitionValidator; trial-builds each descriptor YAML with no-op provider/handler), IDefinitionSource + VolumeDefinitionSource (primary, Flowgent:Definitions:Path, reuses ReadPackage/ComputeVersion) + HttpDefinitionSource (secondary). RE-WIRED: RunOrchestrator (builds via MafWorkflowFactory, drives via MafRunDriver, one terminal transition via dual-write RunStore, HITL via HumanInputRegistry, terminal outcome from descriptor Graph/manifest terminals[]; gRPC/RunStatus/current-step-id preserved), ModuleCatalog (injects IWorkflowGraphProjector + IDeclarativeDefinitionValidator; ApplyPackage merges trial-build errors), ModuleCatalogService (volume-primary/http-secondary via IDefinitionSource; polling/atomic-swap unchanged), IntakeService.RenderTitle (Scriban -> {field} interpolation), EngineOptions (+DefinitionsOptions.Path). DI (RuntimeServiceExtensions): registered the seam + DemoResponseProvider + ModuleToolInvoker + definition sources; DROPPED the IStepHandler and WorkflowCompiler registrations and the flowgent-http client (HttpStepHandler no longer registered) so the MAF path drives runs. EngineEndpoints already descriptor-based from FEAT-002 (no change needed).

PROBE FORMS USED (from FEAT-001 tasks.md): PROBE-C -> ParseJSON ABSENT, so MafWorkflowFactory.MapInput = new ChatMessage(ChatRole.User, input.ToJsonString()) (JSON-string carrier; named-Global extraction is the FEAT-004 YAML's job). PROBE-B -> host reads Global.* from the JSON checkpoint; checkpoint scope key = '<actionId>|@Global|<name>' and the stored cell is { typeId, value } (ReadValueCell unwraps .value). PROBE-A -> structured MCP result is a JSON-OBJECT string read as First(x).field in YAML (FEAT-004), NOT .Value; the seam only serializes to a JSON string.

ANTI-RISK SMOKE EXERCISE (parent condition) ADDED + GREEN: backend/tests/Flowgent.Engine.Tests/Runtime/MafSeamSmokeTests.cs runs 3 declarative workflows through the real seam in Demo mode — (1) SetVariable->SendActivity proving PROBE-B Global output surfacing + terminal; (2) InvokeMcpTool proving the tool runs via ModuleToolHandler/ModuleToolInvoker and the JSON-string result crosses with no Double crash; (3) Question+ConditionGroup proving the HITL gate surfaces AwaitingInput and resumes to Completed. Plus MafSeamUnitTests.cs (pure units: joke topic interpolation, classify rule selection, severity ladder, PowerFx round-trip, projector nodes/edges/outcomes, ExtractGlobals). All 14 seam tests pass. The probe verdicts HELD in the real seam — no stop-and-surface was needed.

DEVIATIONS: (a) RunContext transitional helpers (Templates/CreateScope/CreateIntakeScope/EnterStep budget) are KEPT, not dropped — FEAT-003 keeps the Steps/* files (deletion is FEAT-005) and they still reference these; dropping the DI registrations (not the files) is what switches the run path to MAF. FEAT-005 deletes Steps/* and these helpers together. (b) MafAgentProvider does NOT set ChatOptions.ResponseFormat from a step output schema: the output JSON Schema lives in the declarative YAML (FEAT-004), not the manifest, so there is no manifest-side schema to resolve here; the returned JSON is validated downstream. Telemetry attribution + Demo attachment are intact.

RED SET (catalogued, as directed): `dotnet test --project backend/tests/Flowgent.Engine.Tests` = 181 total, 87 pass / 94 FAIL. This RED is EXPECTED and plan-deferred: the test modules + Flowgent.Fixtures.Module are still custom-format and now route through the MAF path + trial-build validator (which rejects custom-format YAML), and tests still exercise Scriban (TemplateEngineTests/ScriptConversionProperties). FEAT-004 (declarative YAML + fixtures) + FEAT-005 (port tests, delete Scriban/old code) restore this to green; the full-engine-test gate moves there + the convergence loop. Baseline for reference (tasks.md, commit 95a4aea): 157 pass / 7 pre-existing fail. The 14 new seam tests are green within the 87.
